services.desc: Nestled in a tranquil forest clearing, Lavender Ridge Farm offers a unique setting for weddings and special events. With our spacious barn featuring handcrafted wooden beams, soaring ceilings, and large doors, our venue effortlessly blends indoor elegance with outdoor charm. Exchange vows amidst fragrant lavender fields (seasonally available) or in the serene forest clearing by the barn. Capture unforgettable photos in the vibrant fields, by the rustic barns and log cabin, or beneath the canopy of trees. Celebrate under bistro string lights as the sun sets, creating magical memories.
